Summer Fruits Season in AlUla

Celebrate the richness of AlUla's summer harvest at the Al Manshiyah Farmers Market. This vibrant event features a range of locally grown fruit, including delicious mangoes, grapes and figs - highlighting AlUla's deep agricultural roots and cultural heritage.

Ultra Gobi AlUla

Ultra Gobi AlUla marks the first international chapter of the legendary endurance series, bringing its two-decade legacy to the Kingdom's desert landscapes. Across distances from 30km to 400km, athletes traverse open desert, dramatic rock formations, and ancient trade routes. Supported by world-class race infrastructure, this is a journey through endurance, history, and place.

AlUla Trail Race

Every January, AlUla bursts into action with the AlUla Trail Race - a dynamic celebration of endurance and unity set against its breathtaking ancient landscape. Whether you’re tackling the ultra-marathon or cheering on the Kids Run, each course challenges the spirit while weaving through awe-inspiring heritage sites and sandstone wonders. This multi-day event invites runners and supporters alike to come together, creating memories that blend athletic grit with cultural discovery. Expect vibrant energy, international camaraderie, and a festival-like atmosphere the whole family can enjoy.

AlUla Tour

AlUla Tour is a major fixture on the international cycling calendar, attracting the world’s top teams and riders for a multi-stage race through one of the most spectacular landscapes on Earth. From dramatic desert backdrops to iconic landmarks like Maraya and the Oasis, each stage delivers high performance and unforgettable scenery in equal measure. Individual AlUla Tour stages will be announced closer to the race date, but previous editions have seen riders traverse routes from Old Town to Harrat Uwayrid and Winter Park to Wirkah Mountain.

AlFursan Endurance AlUla

The return of AlFursan Endurance AlUla in 2026 marks the seventh edition of this world-class endurance riding event. Known for attracting elite international competitors, AlFursan Endurance AlUla is also a celebration of the area's cultural heritage and natural beauty. Spectators can look forward to captivating performances, traditional experiences, and collaborations with national institutions, all set against AlUla’s breathtaking desert landscapes.

Desert X AlUla 2026

Returning for its fourth edition, Desert X AlUla 2026 explores Space Without Measure, inspired by Kahlil Gibran’s meditations on possibility, perception and the boundless nature of the human spirit. Large-scale, site-specific installations by Saudi and international artists respond to AlUla’s unique landscape, history, and culture. A vibrant programme of tours and events invites deeper engagement, continuing to build AlUla’s legacy as a global destination for art in the landscape. Desert X can be enjoyed in a variety of ways, including on foot - self-guided, or as part of a public or private guided tour - or in the comfort of an open-top car.
